limits: Shortlists are heuristic score/diversity sets, not proven global top-K. Legal combinations may remain unexplored.
Source-scored coordinate calibration has no global joint-calibration guarantee; no SCIP solving is used on the production path.
A valid calibrated hint/incumbent may remain retained independently of ordinary default-score ranking.
Shortlist bounds and time checks prevent domain-size growth; startup, one in-flight source operation and response rendering add small wall-time overhead.
No strict monotonic quality guarantee across separate short/long runs; they can explore different candidates.
Source-model validation does not establish actual Global-client/game fidelity.
